description: Japanese cooking centers on miso and ginger, rice, and sesame oil. Balance of sweet, sour, salty, spicy, and umami in every bite.

attributes.micro_lesson: High heat for wok hei, fish sauce or soy for umami, fresh herbs at the very end.
attributes.shopping_tip: Soy, ginger, garlic, rice, and a hot wok or large skillet.
flavor_building: Start with sesame oil as your cooking medium.
Season with miso and ginger — toast or bloom in fat when using ground spices.
Build the plate around rice as the anchor.
cultural_notes: Respect Japanese food as living tradition — learn context, not just copycat recipes.
